# Third-party code

The Qwen-VL training/data utilities and Qwen visual utilities are derived from
QwenLM/Qwen3-VL and QwenLM/Qwen-VL implementations. The upstream Apache 2.0 license
is retained in `Qwen-LICENSE`. Required upstream credit is not a private path or
a local annotator identity and has not been removed.

Other components are installed as dependencies (Transformers, PEFT, PyTorch,
DeepSpeed, vLLM, decord and metric packages). The v2e simulator is an external
prerequisite and is not copied into this release. Their licenses remain applicable.
